validation_fraction.label: Validation share of each fold's bars

test_fraction.label: Test share of each fold's bars (train is 1 - validation - test)

replay_validation.label: Replay the validation span bar by bar after the fit

step_days.label: Step between folds, in days (0 = test window)

label_kind.label: What is predicted: the direction over the horizon, or a reversal against the previous horizon bars

label_gap_multiple.label: Session gap rule (× typical bar interval, 0 = off)

holding_bars.label: Holding period, in bars (0 = label horizon)

tuning_budget_seconds.label: Time budget per fold, seconds (0 = trials only)

bars_per_second.label: Bars per second (0 = as fast as possible)

unavailableByCategory.unsupervised: Finds structure without labels; it makes no up or down call for the Cycle to trade and score.
unavailableByCategory.semi-supervised: Learns from a few labelled bars plus many unlabelled ones; every Cycle bar is labelled, so it has nothing to add yet.
unavailableByCategory.self-supervised: Learns a representation of the bars without labels; it needs a separate head to make an up or down call.
unavailableByCategory.reinforcement-learning: Learns a trading policy by acting and collecting rewards; the Cycle scores a model's per-bar predictions instead.
unavailableByCategory.generative: Generates new data rather than calling up or down.
unavailableByCategory.hybrid-composite: Combines several models in its own pipeline; not built for the Cycle yet.
unavailableByCategory.probabilistic-symbolic: Works with rules, graphs or symbolic structure rather than a row of bar features.
unavailableByCategory.optimization: Is a search or optimization method, not a model that predicts the next move.
unavailableByCategory.simulation-decision: Simulates or plans decisions rather than predicting the next move from features.
unavailableByCategory.statistical: A statistical model built for a different kind of target (counts, durations, whole-series forecasts); not built for the Cycle yet.
unavailableByCategory.supervised: Not built for the Cycle yet.
unavailableByCategory.neural-network: Not built for the Cycle yet.

unavailableBySubcategory.neural-network/generative-and-latent-mod: Learns to reconstruct or generate its input rather than calling up or down.
unavailableBySubcategory.neural-network/graph-neural-networks: Needs a graph of connected entities; the Cycle reads one instrument's bar features.
unavailableBySubcategory.neural-network/convolutional-networks: Built for images (two-dimensional pixels); the Cycle's convolution model over bars is the temporal convolution network.
unavailableBySubcategory.statistical/time-series-models: Forecasts a whole series from its own past, with no feature row per bar; not built for the Cycle yet.
unavailableBySubcategory.statistical/survival-analysis: Predicts how long until an event happens, not the direction of the next move.

unavailableBySpec.neural-network-architectures-attention-b: Groups the parts of an image into objects; a window of bars has no objects to group.
Cuts an image into patches; the Cycle's attention model over bars is the Transformer encoder.
unavailableBySpec.neural-network-architectures-specialized: Compares pairs of inputs for similarity rather than calling up or down.
Needs spike-train inputs and neuromorphic training.
Built for images: it models parts and their poses.
unavailableBySpec.statistical-models-generalized-linear-mo: Needs three or more classes; the Cycle's label is up or down (with two classes it is logistic regression).
Models counts (0, 1, 2, …); the Cycle's target is a signed price move.
Models positive, skewed amounts; the Cycle's target is a signed price move.
Models non-negative amounts with many zeros; the Cycle's target is a signed price move.
Models counts with extra zeros; the Cycle's target is a signed price move.
unavailableBySpec.statistical-models-regression-techniques: Predicts several targets at once; the Cycle predicts one.
